paragraphs.text: Translates Chinese interface text from installed DeepSeek Harness plugins into English
# dsh-auto-i18n
Translates Chinese interface text from installed DeepSeek Harness plugins into English while you use
hinese interface text from installed DeepSeek Harness plugins into English while you use the web UI.
Most third-party DSH plugins ship Chinese labels, menus, and settings without an English locale. Thi
s plugin translates the rendered text in place, so it works with hardcoded strings too, not only wit
h plugins that provide locale files.
## Install
Install this directory as a bundle with the Harness plugin manager, either from the Plugins page or
with the `plugin_manager` tool (`install_bundle`). The plugin market also accepts a GitHub source: p
oint it at `https://github.com/x01Jin/dsh-auto-i18n`.
The bundle mounts the shipped translation service `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-translator`, so not
hing else needs to be installed.
## Use
Open Settings, then General, and find the Auto translate switch.
Translation is on by default. The switch turns it off and restores the original text without a reloa
d. The choice is kept in browser localStorage.
## What gets translated

- Buttons, labels, menu items, setting rows, dialogs, tooltips, placeholders, and card text.
- Short

descriptions in the plugin market and plugin manager.
- Same-origin iframe documents, which is how
several plugins render a full-page UI (for example a memory workspace embedded at `/lingshu`). Frame
s mounted later and frames nested inside other frames are covered too. Frames inside chat or markdow
n content are left alone, because they hold user material rather than interface text.
Skipped on purpose:

- `pre`, `code`, and `kbd` content, to protect code and commands.
- Text areas and contenteditable e

ditors.
- Text inside markdown-rendered content, including chat messages and plugin README bodies. T

his avoids translating partially streamed output and mangling formatted documents.
- CodeMirror and
Monaco editor content.
## How it works
A client half walks the page, collects text nodes and the `placeholder`, `title`, `aria-label`, and
`alt` attributes that contain Chinese, batches up to 24 strings, and posts them to a host route. The
host translates through Google first and falls back to Bing, keeps a cache at `$DSH_HOME/auto-i18n-
cache.json` (default `~/.dsh/auto-i18n-cache.json`), and returns the results. The client keeps a bro
wser-side cache, so the next page load renders translated text without network calls.
A MutationObserver translates nodes added later, such as panels opened after boot. React re-renders
can overwrite a translation; the observer reapplies it from cache.
The engine also attaches to each same-origin iframe document it finds and observes that document on
its own, so a plugin that renders its UI in a frame behaves like any other part of the page. A frame
that navigates is picked up again on its `load` event; cross-origin frames are skipped because thei
r documents are unreadable.
## Privacy
Text selected for translation is sent to Google's or Bing's anonymous translate endpoints through th
e Harness translator service. No API key or account is used. Results are cached locally; nothing els
e is stored or sent.
## Limitations
- Machine translation without surrounding context. Short labels are usually clear; longer sentences

can read poorly.
- One request per unique string on first encounter. A page with many Chinese labels

takes a few seconds to settle.
- If both providers fail, strings stay untranslated for that session

.
- Cross-origin iframes cannot be translated; only same-origin frames are reachable.
- Translation
applies to the web UI only.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.5 or newer, web UI.
- Node.js 22.19+ or 24+, matching the runtime bundle

d with Desktop.
- Network access to the translation endpoints.
## Files

- `index.js`: host half, translation route, provider calls, disk cache.
- `client.js`: DOM scan, bat

ching, browser cache, settings row.
- `cordis.patch.yml`: inserts the translator service row and the

er cache, settings row.
- `cordis.patch.yml`: inserts the translator service row and the plugin row.
